types.name: parent_specification
types.definition: all carrier, topology, couplings, boundary, controller, and representation data held fixed for the question

types.name: state_space
types.definition: the classical configuration set or quantum Hilbert space belonging to a specified parent

types.name: admissibility_predicate
types.definition: a truth-valued membership test A_P on states of one declared parent

types.name: admissible_subset
types.definition: the subset or closed subspace on which the parent predicate is true

types.name: constraint_generator
types.definition: an operator on a declared common domain whose shifted kernel participates in a constraint presentation

types.name: characteristic_projector
types.definition: an explicitly constructed projector onto a declared closed admissible subspace

types.name: occupied_state
types.definition: the actual classical point, supported measure, vector, or density operator

types.name: fixed_parent_dynamics
types.definition: a declared evolution map that preserves the already specified admissible space

types.name: coarse_graining_map
types.definition: a separately typed conditioning, reconstruction, or effective-description map

types.name: enlarged_parent
types.definition: a global parent with carrier-indexed fibers and representable inter-fiber dynamics

types.name: required_predicate
types.definition: a universal statement over a declared nonempty admissible domain, or singleton value theorem
